_comment: Hand-written synthetic resumes: the ground truth of the resume_extraction suite. Every person, employer, school, address and link is invented (example.test). scripts/build_resume_fixtures.py renders each one to the documents under documents/; the suite holds every extraction to these values. Words are chosen to exercise ligature glyphs (ti, tf, fk, ft, tt, fi, fl), words that must never be 'corrected' (Python, Hybrid, Analytics, Gateway, PyTorch, YAML, BigQuery) and terms no lexicon knows (recognized: false), which must never be dropped.
